method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: Extra data sources: PubMed, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar API keys (empty by default); AI and translation services also take their own keys
apiKey.worksWithout: Metadata updates, journal rankings and citation counts from keyless sources

checkNote: Keys are empty by default (prefs.js: pref("extensions.zotero.zoterobox.api.pubmed_apikey", "");), and the sandbox shows it reaching keyless hosts, so optional holds. In extensions.zotero/content/scripts/zoterobox.js the code has a built-in 'ollama' provider with 'http://localhost:11434' and a check `if(_0x35afb2==='ollama'||_0x35afb2==='lmstudio')return _0x496812;` that sends no auth header. So it can use a local model for its AI features, and 'unknown' was too cautious.
